== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' head-and-shoulders portrait of Ryan Honeyman.
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Ryan Honeyman]].
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution LinkedIn publishes; no larger copy was taken.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of the subject is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use of the photograph.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Ryan Honeyman. Used under fair use for identification only.
